This article describes how to install Thunderbird on Windows.
* If you are upgrading from a previous version of Thunderbird, see [[Update Thunderbird to the latest version]].

{for mac,linux}{note}'''This article only applies to Windows.'''{/note}{/for}

{note}'''Before installing Thunderbird:<br><br>'''
* Make sure that your computer meets the [https://www.mozilla.org/thunderbird/system-requirements/ System Requirements].
{for winxp}
*Although Thunderbird will run on '''Windows XP Service Pack 2 (SP2)''' or above, the latest installers for Thunderbird require '''Windows XP with Service Pack 3 (SP3)'''. If you are running Windows XP SP2, please follow these [[How can I get the latest version of Thunderbird on Windows XP or Vista?|instructions on how to install the latest Thunderbird on your system]].
{/for}
{for winxp}
*Do not install Thunderbird using a limited '''Windows XP''' account. For more information, see [http://support.microsoft.com/kb/2663817 How to determine your user account type in Windows] at microsoft.com.{/for}
{/note}

# Visit the [http://www.getthunderbird.com/ Thunderbird download page] in any browser (e.g. Firefox or Microsoft Internet Explorer). The page will automatically recommend the best version(s) of Thunderbird for you.<br>[[Image:Installing Thunderbird Win 1]] <br>
# Click on the green download link to download the Thunderbird installer. Depending on your connection speed, the download may take up to a few minutes. Thanks for your patience… it’ll be worth the wait!
# Start the process by clicking {button Run}.<br>[[Image:click on run to install thunderbird]] <br>
# Then, just follow the steps (we’ve made the process as painless as possible).<br>[[Image:Welcome to the Thunderbird Setup Wizard]] <br>{note}'''Congratulations, you are done installing Thunderbird!'''{/note}
# Double-click on the Thunderbird icon whenever you want to communicate.<br>[[Image:double click on the thunderbird icon]] <br>
